title: Code Division Multiple Access (CDMA)

source.book: Kurose & Ross, Computer Networking: A Top-Down Approach 8e

keyPoints: Each user has a unique chipping sequence (code); all share the same frequency.
Encoder output Z(i,m) = d(i)·c(m); decoder correlates received chips with the code.
Multiple senders’ signals add in the channel; the right code recovers each one.
